chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Abi Bakr al-Hadrami, from Abi Ja'far and Abi 'Abd Allah, peace be upon them, that they said:
Nothing cuts off the salat except four things: defecation, urination, wind, and sound.

key_terms.أَرْبَعٌ: four specific things mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.الصَّوْتُ: sound here referring to an audible emission associated with breaking wudu (ablution)
key_terms.يَقْطَعُ: invalidates or cuts off in the sense of breaking the prayer

ai.seo_question: What things invalidate salat according to this hadith from al-Istibsar?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning what invalidates salat. It identifies four things that cut off the prayer, all connected to states that nullify ritual purity during worship.
